name: herdr-t3
description: Herdr session GUI client with the T3 Code design system (macOS/Windows)

scripts.start: bun run build && bun run server
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.desktop:build: bun build desktop/main.ts --target node --format cjs --outfile desktop/main.cjs --external electron
scripts.desktop: bun run build && bun run desktop:build && electron .
scripts.desktop:dev: bun run desktop:build && HERDR_T3_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5737 HERDR_T3_PROFILE=dev electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: bun run build && bun run desktop:build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.lint:ui: oxlint src && bun scripts/lint-ui.ts && bun scripts/lint-ui.ts --self-test
